digest.component_or_area: command registry and optional dependency framework
propositions: A top-level command cannot declare one required package extra when optionality varies by nested mode, workflow, analyzer, renderer, or provider without breaking stable verbs and lean diagnostic paths.
A stdlib-only semantic capability registry must enforce that every capability references a declared packaging extra, every route's capability name exists, and no probe imports optional packages.

Capability enforcement must be deferred until after mode/backend selection (e.g., after audit show completes but before audit serve constructs UI, after provider selection but before client construction).
Domain components must retain control of result payloads and logging for unavailable, abstain, and fallback postures; the registry manufactures errors only for error postures via a shared helper.
Stable commands and top-level help must remain present in a no-extras wheel; mcp_server and review_bot must be capabilities but not CLI routes.
